description: We are students from Nanyang Technological University's Students for Exploration and Development of Space (SEDS) club, passionate about anything space related!
summary:
What if you could be the rover?
Opportunity was built to survive 90 days on Mars. However, It lasted nearly 15 years. It rolled into a crater by pure luck, got stuck in a sand trap, survived a dust storm and drove the distance of a marathon. Then in 2018 a planet-wide storm swallowed the sunlight, and the rover fell silent. NASA called out to it for months. It never answered.
We built a 2D pixel-art game that lets players live that journey. Through six chapters, from Eagle Crater to the final dust storm, players guide Opportunity, collect real data, and send it to the scientists at NASA JPL, who talk back with the little rover in warm, funny dialogue. Every site follows the real mission’s order, every photo is real, and every discovery is saved in a mission log with its real date.
Players don’t just read about a mission that ended. They learn to care about it, and about the science that kept it going far longer than anyone expected.
Opportunity was abandoned, but with this game, it is not forgotten.
details: Project Solbounded is a narrative-style 2D game that follow's opportunity rover's 15 year journey. Players learn about iconic contributions that Opportunity made to the study of Mars's geology and history, through bite-sized interactions. The game is intended to be simple and straightforward to play, while also teaching school-level learners about what scientists learned from Opportunity using simple language. We found that the 2D style was quite fitting for the martian's relatively flat terrain, and a sole traveller, Opportunity, travelling its plains. We also made sure to integrate real photos from the Opportunity mission as well as real milestone dates, to have that 'wow' factor when the player realised that these scenes actually happened once. The project is powered by Monstarx, an AI app builder.
